npc_holt_sergeant.name: Holt
npc_holt_sergeant.look: A grizzled, one-eyed old soldier in his sixties with a leather eyepatch, a white beard trimmed close, a faded red quilted jack, leather bracers and a stout practice staff.
npc_holt_sergeant.combat: a veteran: patient, hard to hit, hits hard
npc_holt_sergeant.personality: Gruff, patient and dry; has seen too many young fools die badly armed, so teaches anyone who will sweat. Praises good work grudgingly and bad work never.
npc_holt_sergeant.values: good kit, sweat, keeping young fools alive
npc_holt_sergeant.authority: Lives in the ruined smithy; his yard, his notes, his rules.
npc_holt_sergeant.concerns: Anything in the yard is free to use for making: he says so to anyone. Bandits on the forest road. He wants to see anyone going that way properly armed, and won't arm them himself: they must make it, so they can mend it.

road.text: Two deserters rob travellers on the forest road to the ford.
road.line: Going by the forest road? Two deserters work it. Make sure you're armed.
road.lead: Two deserters rob travellers on the forest road to the ford.

order.text: Grind before you haft; soak rawhide before you bind it.
order.line: Order matters. Grind the head first. Soak the hide before you bind.
order.lead: Holt: grind before you haft; soak rawhide before binding.

npc_holt_sergeant.style: Clipped orders, soldier's slang, a grunt for praise.

samples: Read the notes. Then do it.
On guard, then. Let's see it.
voice.habits: Tests edges with his thumb; raps work with his staff; never gives praise twice.
voice.greeting: Looks you up and down: 'Unarmed. On that road? Hm.'

superstition.text: Holt would want to know how it works.
